[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
if number.nat_part < number then number - number.nat_part else 0
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma nat_part_properties
(number: Rat)
: number.nat_part ≤ number ∧
(number - number.nat_part).nat_part = 0 ∧
(number.nat_part < number ∨ number.nat_part = number) ∧
(number.nat_part = number → number = 0) :=
by
simp [NatPart]
induction number
have h_0: 0.nat_part = 0 ∧
(0 - 0.nat_part).nat_part = 0 ∧
(0.nat_part < 0 ∨ 0.nat_part = 0) ∧
(0.nat_part = 0 → 0 = 0) := by
  simp [NatPart]
  split
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp
have h_pos: (number + 1).nat_part = (number.nat_part + 1) ∧
  ((number + 1) - (number.nat_part + 1)).nat_part = 0 ∧
  (number.nat_part + 1 < number + 1 ∨ number.nat_part + 1 = number + 1) ∧
  (number.nat_part + 1 = number + 1 → number + 1 = 0) := by
  simp [NatPart]
  split
  · simp
  · simp [NatPart]
  · split
    · simp [NatPart]
    · simp [NatPart]
  · simp [NatPart]
  · simp [NatPart]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
unfold problem_spec
let result := implementation number
use result
simp [result]
simp [implementation]
have h_pos: number > 0 := by
  rw [NatPart]
  exact NatPart.pos
have h_res_nonneg: 0 ≤ result := by
  simp [NatPart]
  rw [NatPart]
  exact NatPart.nonneg
have h_res_lt_1: result < 1 := by
  by_cases h_num_eq_nat_part: number = number.nat_part
  · rw [h_num_eq_nat_part]
    simp
  · simp [NatPart]
    linarith
have h_sum_eq_num: number.nat_part + result = number := by
  by_cases h_num_eq_nat_part: number = number.nat_part
  · rw [h_num_eq_nat_part]
    simp
  · simp [NatPart]
    linarith
exact ⟨result, h_res_nonneg, h_res_lt_1, h_sum_eq_num⟩
[END]
